title: when-condition evaluation
description: Port lib/when.js: object = AND, array = OR-of-ANDs (no short-circuit for activity keys so churn refs bootstrap). Conditions: fileExists, envSet/envNotSet, variablesPresent, signal, phase (cheap gates); linesChanged (git churn since per-task ref, floored to session baseline), linesWritten (gross churn), sourcesModifiedSinceLastRun, toolsUsed, sourceFilesEdited, testFilesEdited (activity). Pi adaptation: tool names lowercase, edit tracking comes from tool_result events.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests per condition incl. skip-reason strings; churn tests use a real temp git repo

title: Stop-equivalent prove-done loop
description: Map prove_it Stop to pi: on agent_before_settle (or turn_end), run Stop agent/script tasks. On FAIL: return { continue: true, entries: [...] } with a boundary message containing the review failure so the model fixes issues, then next settle re-reviews. Guard against infinite loops: consecutive-failure limit -> warn and allow settle. Advance task churn ref on PASS; update last-stop checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Harness tests: fail -> continue requested with feedback; pass -> settle allowed; loop limit -> enforced; churn ref advances on pass

title: Agent reviewer runner
description: Port lib/reviewer.js + lib/checks/agent.js: spawn agent tasks with expanded prompt. Default command 'pi -p --no-session' (config override); gpt-* models route to 'codex exec -'. parseVerdict (PASS/FAIL/SKIP with markdown stripping), --output-format json parsing, maxTurns final-turn recovery prompt, verdict classification fallback, empty-output recovery. Respect configModel per-event defaults (tool_call -> fast model, stop review -> stronger). prompts resolved via promptType skill or inline text.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for verdict parsing incl. adversarial formats; harness test runs reviewer against a stub command (echo) for pass/fail/skip/error paths

title: tool_result tracking + test-first TDD state machine
description: pi.on('tool_result'): record file edits (edit/write paths) for sourceFilesEdited/testFilesEdited conditions; detect test command runs (lib/testing.js isTestCommand) for TDD green. Port libexec/test-first state machine (idle/needs-test/needs-red/needs-green + refactor editsSinceTestRun) as extension-internal logic emitting block reasons on tool_call instead of hook JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Harness tests: sequence source-edit xN without tests -> next edit blocked with TDD nudge; running failing then passing test advances state; phase=refactor switches counter

title: tool_call guards: matchers, triggers, script checks
description: Port PreToolUse dispatch to pi.on('tool_call'): task.matcher regex against toolName (pi names are lowercase: read|bash|edit|write), triggers regex (case-insensitive) against input.command for bash. Run matching script tasks synchronously; block via { block: true, reason } on fail, pass otherwise. Stdin JSON payload: toolName, input, params, projectDir, sessionId equivalents. Handle appeal/consecutive-failure flow and suspension checks. Quiet tasks log-only.
acceptance_criteria: Harness tests: matcher miss -> no run; trigger hit -> runs; exit 1 -> blocked with reason; timeout -> treated as fail; crash -> BOOM logged, pass-open

title: Script task runner (async + parallel)
description: Port lib/checks/script.js + async_worker: tryRun with timeout, output truncation to format.maxOutputChars, exit-code pass/fail, record to review log. task.async spawns detached with notify-on-finish; task.parallel forks and awaits at boundary. env from config.taskEnv + env-task vars.
acceptance_criteria: Harness tests cover pass/fail/timeout/truncation/async-detach paths

title: Session state store + git baseline
description: Port lib/session.js file-based store keyed by pi session id under ~/.pi-prove-it/sessions/: saveSessionState/loadSessionState, review log (.jsonl for monitor), git baseline {is_repo, root, head, status_hash} captured on first event, file-edits tracker (recordPathsTouched from tool_result of edit/write), command results reader, phase + signal getters/setters. Derive session id from ctx.sessionManager; survive reload/fork via session_start reason handling.
acceptance_criteria: Harness tests: state round-trips, baseline recorded once, edits tracked across tool_result events

title: Session briefing + env tasks
description: On session_start: (1) render orientation briefing (port lib/briefing.js renderBriefing: obligations, automated checks per event, signal/phase reference) and inject so the model sees it — via before_agent_start system prompt section or a custom message; (2) run env tasks (startup/resume only), collect vars into taskEnv used by all script/agent subprocesses, surface errors as notifications; (3) log baseline checks like local-shim-check equivalent.
acceptance_criteria: Harness test: briefing text rendered from fixture config appears in injected content; env vars present in subsequent task subprocess env

title: Extension skeleton + event wiring
description: index.ts exporting default factory receiving ExtensionAPI. Register pi.on handlers for session_start, tool_call, tool_result, turn_end, agent_before_settle + registerCommand for /prove-it:* commands (stub). Respect runtime lifecycle: no work in factory, cleanup in session_shutdown. Load config on session_start, cache per-session.
acceptance_criteria: Harness test: extension loads, handlers registered, no-ops gracefully when no config exists

title: Epic: Guards + tool blocking
description: tool_call blocking guards, script checks, tool_result tracking, TDD test-first state machine.

title: Epic: Session lifecycle (session_start)
description: Extension skeleton with event wiring; session_start behavior: briefing injection, git baseline, session state store, env tasks.

title: Epic: Stop flow + agent reviews
description: Agent reviewer tasks and the prove-done loop: block agent settle until review passes.

title: Config cascade loader + hooks merge
description: Port lib/config.js: loadEffectiveConfig walks global (~/.pi/agent/prove-it/config.json) -> ancestor .pi/prove-it/config.json files (root-to-cwd) -> cwd config.json -> config.local.json. Merge hooks two-level {type:{event:[tasks]}} by task name (same-name replaces, new-name appends). Track userKeys so top-level 'model' only applies when user-set. Validation with clear errors. buildConfig() for init.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover: precedence, ancestor walk, same-name replacement, new-name append, local overrides, invalid config errors

title: guard-config: block edits to prove-it config
description: Standalone script (libexec/guard-config) wired as a quiet tool_call-blocking script task. params.paths with default fallback to .pi/prove-it/config.json + config.local.json. Reads stdin JSON payload (toolName, input) and exits nonzero / emits block when a guarded path is being written.
acceptance_criteria: Harness test: tool_call to write config file is blocked with guard reason; other files pass

title: Config defaults as single source of truth
description: Port lib/defaults.js: CONFIG_DEFAULTS (enabled, sources, tests, format.maxOutputChars, maxAgentTurns, taskAllowedTools, taskEnv, fileEditingTools...), DEFAULT_MODELS per event, DEFAULT_ALLOWED_TOOLS. Adapted for pi: config path becomes .pi/prove-it/config.json; fileEditingTools default to pi tool names (edit, write); agent tasks default to 'pi -p' instead of 'claude -p'. No ||-fallbacks downstream — everything reads from merged config.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests assert every default; runtime config always fully populated

title: Verification tier 3: e2e runs against real pi
description: E2E harness: fixture projects under test/fixtures, each with a pi-prove-it config; run real 'pi --extension ./index.ts -p <prompt> --mode json' with PATH shim; assert transcript JSON shows (a) briefing injected, (b) bash command blocked with guard reason, (c) stop blocked until test script passes. Requires API key in env: skip gracefully (t.skip) when absent. Keep prompts tiny/cheap; allow model override via env (PI_PROVE_IT_E2E_MODEL).
acceptance_criteria: Running script/test with an API key exercises >=3 e2e scenarios end-to-end; without key they skip with a clear message

title: Verification tier 1: in-process extension harness
description: THE core mechanism for proving behavior. Build a mock ExtensionAPI + ExtensionContext (records pi.on registrations, registerCommand/registerTool calls; controllable ctx.ui, sessionManager, cwd) and a dispatch helper that loads the extension factory and fires synthetic events (session_start, tool_call, tool_result, turn_end, agent_before_settle). Tests then assert on: blocked tool calls with reason, continuation requests at Stop-equivalent, injected briefing content, logged task results. Direct analog of prove_it's test/integration/hook-harness.js.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can load the extension, fire every mapped Pi event, and expose all blocking/continuation/notify outputs for assertion. Used by all later feature tests.

title: Verification tier 2: unit test suite
description: Port prove_it's unit test patterns to node:test (zero deps): config cascade/merge, template expansion, when-condition evaluation, verdict parsing, git churn refs, session state store. Lint with standard. script/test = lint + unit.
acceptance_criteria: npx standard clean; script/test green with meaningful coverage of every lib module

title: Scaffold pi-prove-it repo
description: Set up ~/code/pi-prove-it as an npm package distributable via 'pi install npm:pi-prove-it'. Includes: package.json with pi package manifest (pi key declaring extension entry + skills, peerDependencies on @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent with * range, bin entry for CLI), tsconfig (jiti loads TS directly, no build step needed but types matter), MIT LICENSE crediting Justin Searls / searlsco as original author of prove_it, README stub, .gitignore, script/test runner, git remote git@github.com:jrgifford/pi-prove-it.git.
acceptance_criteria: package.json has pi manifest + bin; LICENSE is MIT and credits searls; script/test runs node:test suite; repo pushes to jrgifford/pi-prove-it

title: Epic: Config layer
description: Port prove_it config system: defaults single-source, cascade global->ancestors->project->local, hooks merge by task name, validation, guard-config.

title: Epic: Scaffold repo + verification foundation
description: Create ~/code/pi-prove-it as an installable pi package (pi install npm:pi-prove-it) and build the verification tiers that prove every feature works: (1) in-process extension harness with mocked ExtensionAPI, (2) unit tests, (3) e2e runs of real pi against fixture projects.

title: Agent reviewer skills (prove-coverage, prove-done)
description: Distribute reviewer prompts as pi skills in the package (skills/ directory declared under pi key): prove-coverage.md and prove-done.md adapted from prove_it's Claude skills, with template variables documented. promptType:'skill' resolution reads the packaged skill file. Verify pi package loader picks them up (pi install from local path + /config shows resources).
acceptance_criteria: Local-path pi install loads extension + skills; harness test resolves promptType skill prompts from package dir

title: Git hooks: shims + dispatcher
description: Port lib/dispatcher/git.js + lib/init.js shim management: init installs .git/hooks/pre-commit and pre-push shims calling 'prove-it hook git:<event>'. Dispatcher runs git tasks with no session (sessionId null), exit 1 on failure with reason on stderr, respects PROVE_IT_DISABLED. Under pi headless runs (PI_PROVE_IT_SESSION env set by extension) hooks apply; human commits stay no-ops.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests: shim install/uninstall, dispatcher pass/fail against temp repo with fixture config

title: CLI: install/uninstall/init/deinit/doctor/prefix
description: Port cli.js + lib/commands: install (write global config ~/.pi/agent/prove-it/config.json with enabled:true; note: pi loads the extension via pi install npm:pi-prove-it — our install only manages config + guidance), uninstall, init/deinit project-level (.pi/prove-it/config.json + git shim wiring), doctor (check pi on PATH, extension loaded, config parseable, git available, reviewer command reachable), prefix (print package dir for $(prove-it prefix) style script refs), enable/disable, phase, signal.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests drive each command against temp HOME/project dirs and assert file effects + doctor output

title: Template variables + conditional blocks
description: Port lib/template.js: lazy resolvers for staged_diff, staged_files, working_diff, changed_files, session_diff (diffs since last review checkpoint via file-edit tracking), test_output, tool_command, file_path, project_dir, root_dir, session_id, git_head, git_status, recent_commits, files_changed_since_last_run, sources, signal_message, phase, edit_* vars. {{#var}}...{{/var}} conditional blocks. getUnknownVars for validation warnings.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests per variable with fixture git repos; conditional block keep/strip behavior

title: Async/parallel/arbiter/backchannel
description: Port remaining dispatch features: async task completion surfaced as notification at next boundary; parallel task fork/join at boundary; arbiter suspension + appeal flow (script task consecutive failures -> suspended -> appeal re-runs); backchannel dir for bypassing reviews (/prove-it:catchup); retry model routing for agent tasks. Group into this issue only if small; split if each grows.
acceptance_criteria: Harness tests for: async result applied at next boundary, parallel join, suspension + appeal cycle, catchup clears backchannel

title: Epic: CLI + git hooks
description: prove-it CLI (install/uninstall/init/deinit/doctor/monitor/phase/signal/cancel/catchup/prefix) and git hook dispatch (pre-commit/pre-push).

title: Epic: Packaging + docs
description: pi package manifest, agent-reviewer skills, example projects, full README.

title: Epic: Conditions + templates
description: when-condition evaluation and {{template}} variable expansion for prompts/scripts.

title: Example projects + full README
description: Port example/basic and example/advanced fixture projects to .pi/prove-it configs (guards, stop review, TDD). README: what it is, quick start (pi install npm:pi-prove-it, prove-it init), config reference (all task types, params, when, template vars), event mapping table Claude Code -> pi, verification strategy (3 tiers), credit to Justin Searls' prove_it as the origin.
acceptance_criteria: Examples validated by a test that loads each fixture config through the cascade loader; README covers every config field that exists in defaults

title: Monitor + cancel + catchup
description: Port lib/monitor.js (tail ~/.pi-prove-it/sessions/*.jsonl human-readable with colors, --project filter, session listing), cancel (kill running dispatcher by pid file), catchup (advance refs/checkpoints so reviewers do not re-review a big repo change). Adapt monitor paths and event tags to pi event names (tool-call, stop, session-start).
acceptance_criteria: Monitor renders fixture log fixtures deterministically (snapshot tests); cancel kills a stub long-running dispatcher; catchup clears pending review state
